answer_1.quote: One important downstream task for disentangled representation learning (DRL) is conditional generation. Our MI-based text DRL method can be also embedded into an Encoder-Decoder generative model and trained end-to-end.
answer_1.outputs: generated sentences via style transfer and conditional generation

answer_2.quote: To measure generation quality for both tasks, we test the following metrics... Style Preservation... Content Preservation... Generation Quality... Geometric Mean...

answer_4.quote: we further test our disentangled representation effectiveness by human evaluation... we ask 10 human annotators to justify the style label, content preservation and content fluency.
answer_4.guideline: The style label is 0 or 1 representing the positive or negative sentiment of the given sentence. The content preservation and the content fluency is scored between 0 to 5.
